briefdescription.para: Demonstrates the XilMailbox library by sending an IPI to self.

detaileddescription.para: This example demonstrates the usage of the mailbox library APIs. Each IPI channel can trigger an interrupt to itself and can exchange messages through the message buffer. The example uses this feature to exercise the library APIs.

Example control flow:
Initializes the XMailbox instance.
Writes a message and triggers an IPI to self in blocking mode.
The interrupt handler receives the IPI and sends back the response.
Reads the received response and does a sanity check.
Prints PASS or FAIL based on the sanity check of the response message.
